variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Uses := for assignment with type inference or explicit types.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.code:
Int i := 1
Float f := 2.0f
Bool b := true
Str s := "Text"
data_types.notes: Uses capitalized names for built-in types.

conditionals.title: Conditionals

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Methods defined on classes, similar to Java/C#.

arrays.title: Arrays (Lists)
arrays.notes: Fantom uses Lists instead of arrays.

error_handling.title: Error Handling

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Fantom provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Fantom supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Fantom provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Fantom converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Fantom represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Fantom formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Fantom branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Fantom defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Fantom iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Fantom organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Fantom stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Fantom groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Fantom tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Fantom organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
